answer.reason: Hazor has defining events: it was taken and burned by Joshua, and later taken by Tiglathpileser.

clauses.english: was taken and burned with fire by Joshua, and its king killed
was taken by Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and its people carried captive to Assyria
clauses.quote: took Ijon, and Abelbethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor

doubts: JOS 12:19 and JOS 19:36 only list Hazor, so they were not used.
1KI 9:15 (Solomon's levy to build Hazor) was left out as a minor detail.
JDG 4:2 and 1SA 12:9 name Hazor only through Jabin and Sisera, which the summary already covers.
